name: Hawaiian-Style Ham Sandwich with Pineapple, Avocado & Ranch Coleslaw

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small pineapple
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
½ avocado

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add to the bowl with the pineapple.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Add cabbage and dressing to the bowl; toss to combine the slaw and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (14 oz) bag shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
¼ cup ranch dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Cut ham steak into 4 portions and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Sprinkle steaks with sugar and pepper on the top-side.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 oz ham steak, boneless
1 tsp brown sugar
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil steaks until golden brown, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To assemble the sandwiches, layer the bottom half of each bun with two ham steaks and a small portion of slaw. Close with the top half of each bun. (Reserve remaining slaw for serving.)
Divide sandwiches between plates and serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!
